review_metadata.review_type: Final Code Review - Post-Iteration Security Validation

feedback.issue: Original SCAN cursor implementation prevents Redis blocking on large datasets
feedback.suggestion: Implementation verified - SCAN cursor properly replaces KEYS in confidence-scoring.ts, pattern-promotion.ts, and performance-feedback.ts. Cursor loop correctly terminates on cursor='0'. Safety limit of 10,000 keys prevents memory exhaustion. No further action needed.

feedback.issue: Redis namespace injection risk from regex allowing ':' character
feedback.suggestion: Regex pattern hardened in pattern-promotion.ts line 403. Changed from /^[a-zA-Z0-9:_-]+$/ to /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/. Now validates key suffix only, not full key with namespace. Prevents bypass of namespace boundaries. Consistent with confidence-scoring.ts pattern (line 136). No further action needed.

feedback.issue: Missing SCAN-specific test case for cursor iteration
feedback.suggestion: Add test case to verify detectSimilarPatterns and autoArchivePatterns functions work correctly with >100 patterns requiring multiple cursor iterations. Test should verify all patterns are processed and safety limit is respected. Estimated effort: 30 minutes. Schedule for v1.1 release.

Add inline comment explaining why 10,000 key limit was chosen (memory consumption O(n*100) where n is cursor iterations, each iteration up to 100 keys). Document that for datasets with >10,000 patterns, migration to index-based approach is recommended. Estimated effort: 15 minutes.

feedback.issue: Console logging instead of logger abstraction
feedback.suggestion: Replace console.log/warn statements with optional debug logging that supports logger injection for production use. Current implementation acceptable for v1.0 since debug flag exists, but recommend abstraction in v1.1 for centralized logging. Effort: 1 hour.

feedback.issue: Algorithm correlation detection is O(n²) pattern-to-update matching
feedback.suggestion: Current implementation suitable for <1000 patterns. For larger datasets, implement date-based index for pattern failures to reduce complexity. Add performance benchmarks to document scale characteristics. Defer to v1.2 optimization cycle. Not blocking for v1.0.

feedback.issue: Minimal audit logging for compliance tracking
feedback.suggestion: Current error handling and feedback history sufficient for v1.0. Recommend adding pattern change audit trail in v1.1+ for compliance scenarios. Example: log all pattern confidence changes with timestamp, old/new values, reason. Effort: 2 hours.
